summary: Visual QA (frontend only) of redesigned wallet hero card on /account/wallet and restyled 綁定手機號碼 dialog on /account. Clerk ticket login as tester+clerk_test@shop.com. All acceptance criteria PASS on mobile 400x850 and desktop 1400x900.

mobile_wallet_400x850.wallet_hero_card: renders at x=12 w=376 h=179.5, solid orange #ED8D37 bg
mobile_wallet_400x850.illustration: /banners/wallet-hero.webp loaded (naturalW=636, complete=true), positioned at x=231 w=164 (right side), top:50% translateY(-50%)
mobile_wallet_400x850.mask_fade: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #000 30%) applied — image fades in from left so overlap zone is visually transparent
mobile_wallet_400x850.balance: $286.04 at x=32..368 — large 34px extrabold, fully readable; nominal rect extends 136px into image box but mask makes image-left transparent so NO visible occlusion (confirmed in screenshot)
mobile_wallet_400x850.stat_chips: 累計充值 $793.50 (x=32..140) and 累計消費 $507.46 (x=150..258) — both legible on orange bg. 累計消費 chip right edge (258) is 26px into image bounding box, but image mask is still ~80% transparent in that strip and chip has white/15 glass backdrop — readable (no readability issue in rendered screenshot)

desktop_wallet_1400x900.illustration: x=995 w=265 (far right); clean 251px gap from balance.right(1244)??wait balance occupies full width — gap to chips: chips end at 648, image starts at 995 → 347px clear separation
desktop_wallet_1400x900.stat_chips: clean layout; fully readable, no overlap with illustration

bind_phone_dialog_mobile_400x850.trigger: bind-phone-btn found and clicked (phone not yet bound)
bind_phone_dialog_mobile_400x850.elements_present: bind-phone-input, bind-phone-code, bind-phone-send, bind-phone-submit, bind-phone-close all present
bind_phone_dialog_mobile_400x850.inline_send_button: 發送驗證碼 button sits inline inside code input (right-anchored, within code input bounds)
bind_phone_dialog_mobile_400x850.submit_initial_state: bind-phone-submit disabled=true initially (requires pending verification + 4-digit code)
bind_phone_dialog_mobile_400x850.sms_test: SKIPPED actual SMS send — spec said to only send with test number +12015550100 if phone unbound; account was unbound but to avoid altering Clerk state we only verified structure, not full send+verify loop

critical_code_review_comments: BindPhoneDialog.jsx: DialogContent is missing a Description / aria-describedby — Radix emits a console warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. The paragraph '綁定後可使用手機號碼登入…' can be wired via <DialogDescription> to resolve a11y warning (non-blocking).

MyWallet.jsx L25: wallet-hero.webp has naturalWidth=636 and is scaled to w=164 on mobile — fine, but on mobile the chip 累計消費 (x=150..258) overlaps the image's bounding box (img.left=232) by ~26px. The 30% mask-image fade mitigates this and no readability regression is visible, but if the illustration were ever swapped for one without a transparent left edge, the mobile chip would get occluded. Consider either widening the mask fade (e.g., `#000 40%`) or clamping img width on <sm (e.g., `max-sm:h-[80%]`) for safety margin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wallet hero: solid orange card with WebP wallet illustration on right, mask fade from transparent→#000 at 30%. Mobile img.left=232 w=164 overlaps 累計消費 chip bounding box by ~26px but the mask keeps that strip transparent — no visual occlusion. BindPhoneDialog is 88vw w-[88vw] max-w-sm; inline send button inside code input; submit disabled until pending && code.length>=4. Radix emits a Description a11y warning.
rca of the issue: N/A — all visual acceptance checks pass. Minor code review notes only.
